clue.text: What a defender does as one shoots?

definitions.meaning: in football a defender marks an opposing player, keeping close to him: he marks a man
a person who fires a gun with skill, a crack shot

explanation.surface: A footballing puzzle about what the back line does when an opponent takes a shot.
explanation.walkthrough: Split as MARKS MAN, the first reading is the defender's job; read whole, it is a sharpshooter. 'as' just joins the two.
explanation.definitionFit: A skilled rifle or pistol shot is described by this word, a synonym for sharpshooter.

clue.text: Looking back, they're simply concealing suffering

indicators.note: Looking back says the hidden letters are read backwards
concealing says the letters lie hidden within the neighbouring words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Looking back, they were just hiding their pain.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft put concealing in the definition, but it is the hiding indicator; Looking back then reverses the letters found in they're simply.
explanation.definitionFit: Great distress or wretchedness is a synonym for suffering.

clue.text: Trump: a sour, crazy, male is wanting reception like this?

definitions.note: the definition describes a kind of welcome, so it stands for an adjective

indicators.note: crazy says the letters are jumbled madly
wanting means lacking, so a letter is missing from the jumble

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A sour, unhinged Trump wants the crowd to give him an ecstatic welcome.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crazy' rearranges TRUMP A SOUR, and 'is wanting' takes out the M, leaving the nine letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A wildly enthusiastic, ecstatic welcome is the sort of reception described.

clue.text: Let down by actor regularly: average performer on stage

parts.note: to stand someone up is to fail to meet them, to let them down

indicators.note: regularly picks every other letter of actor

parts.note: the median is a kind of average

explanation.surface: A disappointing actor, an average performer on stage.
explanation.definitionFit: A comic who tells jokes solo in front of an audience is a stage performer.

clue.text: Declares a burden uplifting

indicators.note: in a down clue lifting up reads the letters from bottom to top

parts.note: stress is a load or strain, a burden

explanation.surface: Someone states that carrying a load can be good for the spirit.
explanation.definitionFit: To state something firmly and confidently is to declare it, a synonym.

clue.text: Loud hiccup extremely difficult to sustain

indicators.note: difficult letters are awkward and unruly, so the pooled letters are rearranged
extremely asks for the extreme letters, first and last, of hiccup

explanation.surface: Someone with a noisy case of hiccups finds it hard to keep them going, or to keep a straight face.
explanation.walkthrough: 'extremely' gives HP, the ends of 'hiccup'; 'difficult' rearranges LOUD with HP.
explanation.definitionFit: To sustain a decision or principle is to support it or keep it standing, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Imagine after booking it might result in a sending off

definitions.text: it might result in a sending off

parts.note: to picture something is to imagine it
post is Latin for after, as in postwar
in football a booking is a yellow card from the referee

explanation.surface: A football image: think of a player booked, which could lead to his sending off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sending off' is a football dismissal on the surface, but here it means posting something; a booking is a yellow card in football.
explanation.definitionFit: A holiday card with a photograph on it is something you send off in the mail.

clue.text: It's no secret how distance is related to speed

definitions.meaning: something open and plain to see, not hidden

definitions.text: how distance is related to speed
definitions.meaning: speed is distance over time, and t is the symbol for time, so read as two parts it says over t

explanation.surface: Everyone knows the physics formula linking distance and speed.
explanation.walkthrough: The second definition is cryptic: speed equals distance divided by time, said as 'over T'.
explanation.definitionFit: Open, done in plain view and not concealed, is the opposite of secret.

clue.text: Individual's record concerning the banks

parts.note: a disc is a gramophone record
re means about or concerning, as in letters

indicators.note: a river's banks are its edges, so only the outer letters of the word are kept

explanation.surface: Someone's record of dealings with the banks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'banks' takes the edges of 'the', giving TE.
explanation.definitionFit: Separate and distinct, as with individual parts, is the meaning.

clue.text: Very quietly cuts Lady Garden, perhaps, in shower

indicators.note: cuts means slicing into the other word, so these letters go inside it

parts.note: Baroness Garden of Frognal sits in the House of Lords, so she is a peer; perhaps marks her as one example
pp, pianissimo, is the musical mark for very quietly

explanation.surface: A cheeky picture of discreet trimming of the pubic hair in the shower.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lady garden' is British slang for pubic hair, but Lady Garden is also a real member of the House of Lords.
explanation.definitionFit: To pepper a target is to shower it, scattering many small objects over it.

clue.text: As photographs can be copies, one is framed in retrospect

indicators.note: one is surrounded by the other letters as a picture is by a frame
looking back in time, so the word for copies is read backwards

parts.note: to ape someone is to copy them, so copies means apes
the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: Old photographs come in brownish tones, and copies of them are framed for nostalgic viewing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in retrospect' turns APES into SEPA; 'is framed' puts I inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Old photographs are often printed in a reddish-brown tint named after cuttlefish ink.

clue.text: Drawers of small vessels containing dash of rum

parts.note: S is the standard abbreviation for small, as on clothing sizes

indicators.note: the boats hold the letter from rum inside them

parts.note: ketches are two-masted sailing boats

indicators.note: a dash is just a small splash, so only the opening letter of rum is used

explanation.surface: Chests of drawers made of little boats with a splash of rum aboard, a nautical image.
explanation.definitionFit: Drawers here are people who draw pictures, artists making quick rough studies.

clue.text: A visit to the bar and back?

definitions.text: A visit to the bar and back?

parts.words: A visit to the bar and back?
parts.note: going to the bar to buy a round of drinks and returning, a journey there and back again

explanation.surface: Fetching drinks for friends at the pub and coming back to the table.
explanation.walkthrough: Buying a 'round' at the pub is a 'trip' to the bar; put together, it is a journey out and home again.
explanation.definitionFit: A journey out and returning to the start is the meaning; the bar errand is the joke.

clue.text: Absolute state

definitions.meaning: complete or total, as in nonsense that is complete
to say or voice something aloud, as a verb

explanation.surface: Political jargon: an absolute state, as in absolute monarchy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Absolute state' reads as one political term, but it is two separate definitions.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means total or complete; the verb means to speak or express in words.

clue.text: South American natives' secretive, secretive matter?

parts.note: coy means reluctant to give details, secretive
pus is matter secreted by an infected wound, so it is secretive in a punning sense

explanation.surface: Native South Americans who are secretive about some hidden matter.
explanation.walkthrough: The repeated 'secretive' plays first as coy, then as 'secreted'.
explanation.definitionFit: These are large water-dwelling rodents native to South America, also farmed for nutria fur.

clue.text: Choose to bring back made-to-measure electric blankets

indicators.note: blankets as a verb covers or conceals, so the letters lie hidden in the words

explanation.surface: Someone picks out custom-made electric blankets again.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters sit across the end of 'made-to-measure' and the start of 'electric'.
explanation.definitionFit: To vote someone back into office is to choose them again for a further term.

clue.text: Face of joy hiding grievous heart

indicators.note: hiding holds the other letters concealed inside

parts.note: elation is great happiness, joy

indicators.note: the heart of a word is its centre letters

explanation.surface: A face showing joy while hiding a grieving heart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heart' takes EV, the middle of 'grievous'; 'hiding' puts it inside ELATION.
explanation.definitionFit: In architecture an elevation is one side or face of a building as drawn.

clue.text: New Pope is to converse

indicators.note: new letters are made from the old ones by rearranging them

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A newly elected Pope is going to talk with his flock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'converse' looks like a verb meaning talk, but it is the noun meaning reverse.
explanation.definitionFit: The converse of a statement is its reverse or contrary, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Faint sullen look comes over fool

indicators.note: the sulky look goes round the other word, covering it

parts.note: a pout is a sulky pushing-out of the lips
an ass is a stupid person

explanation.surface: A fool suddenly wearing a faint, sulky expression.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb, to faint is to lose consciousness, to keel over and collapse.

clue.text: Present concluding part of reciprocatory pact

parts.note: a treat is a gift or present

indicators.note: only the very last letter of reciprocatory is taken

explanation.surface: Presenting the final clause of a mutual agreement.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal agreement between states is a pact.

clue.text: Interrupted brother gaining knowledge

indicators.note: gaining says the first word acquires the second, joined on its end

parts.note: bro is an informal short form of brother
ken means range of knowledge, as in beyond my ken

explanation.surface: A brother who was interrupted while learning something.
explanation.definitionFit: Interrupted sleep or a disrupted line is described with this word, meaning not continuous.

clue.text: Spread of British hatred is grotesque

indicators.note: grotesque means distorted and misshapen, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: The spread of British hatred is grotesque.
explanation.definitionFit: Width or wingspan, how far something extends across, is its spread.

clue.text: Maybe Ant and Dec finally accepted by fashionable crowd

parts.note: in means fashionable, as in the in thing

indicators.note: accepted by means taken in, so the letter goes inside the other two words

parts.note: a set is a group of people, a crowd

indicators.note: finally takes just the last letter of Dec

explanation.surface: Ant and Dec, the British TV presenting duo, are welcomed by the fashionable crowd.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ant and Dec' looks like a single name, the TV duo, but the clue is split after 'Ant'.
explanation.definitionFit: An ant is one example of a six-legged creature, so 'Maybe' marks it as an example.

clue.text: Nothing to like in talk

parts.note: O, the shape of zero, stands for nothing
to rate someone is to think well of them, to like them

explanation.surface: There is nothing to like about talk, a grumble.
explanation.definitionFit: To speak formally and at length, as in a speech, is a synonym for talking.

clue.text: Very legal to go topless

indicators.note: topless means losing the top, which in a down answer is the first letter

parts.note: lawful means permitted by law, legal

explanation.surface: It is perfectly legal to sunbathe topless.
explanation.walkthrough: Informally, 'awful' means very, as in 'awful nice'.
explanation.definitionFit: In casual speech the word is an intensifier meaning extremely, as in an awful long way.

clue.text: Ogles coach and gets complaint

parts.note: to eye someone is to look at them, to ogle
to train someone is to coach them

explanation.surface: Someone ogles a sports coach and gets a complaint lodged against them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'complaint' means an ailment here, not a grievance.
explanation.definitionFit: A medical complaint is an ailment, and tired, sore eyes from overuse are one such condition.

clue.text: Visited female client I'd upset

indicators.note: upset means overturned or knocked about, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A woman customer of a business got upset.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Visited' is used in its old sense of punishment imposed, as in the sins visited upon a family.
explanation.definitionFit: To visit a punishment or plague on someone is to impose or deal it out, the same sense.

clue.text: Tolerate being tender in hospital department

indicators.note: in places the offer inside the department's letters

parts.note: A and E is the British hospital accident and emergency department, the emergency room
a tender is a bid or offer to do work

explanation.surface: Putting up with being sore while waiting in a hospital ward.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tender' looks like sore, but it is an offer.
explanation.definitionFit: To put up with or stand something is a direct synonym, as in can't stand it.

clue.text: Cockney's recovering in London district

indicators.note: a Cockney Londoner drops the h at the start of words

parts.note: a wound that is recovering is healing

explanation.surface: A Cockney convalescing in a part of London.
explanation.walkthrough: A Cockney is a working-class East Londoner, whose accent drops initial H.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a borough in west London, famous for its film studios.

clue.text: Mystery of wife and husband getting one to hide naked body

indicators.note: the outer letters conceal the inner ones by enclosing them
getting says the couple acquire the next piece, added after them

parts.note: W is the abbreviation for wife, used in genealogy
a unit is a single thing, one

indicators.note: naked strips the outer letters, leaving only the middle of body

explanation.surface: A married couple concealing a corpse, the plot of a murder story.
explanation.walkthrough: 'naked' strips B and Y from 'body', leaving OD; 'to hide' puts OD inside WHUNIT.
explanation.definitionFit: A detective novel built around who committed the murder is a mystery story.
